videos.title: Micron Idaho 無塵室建置與潔淨度準備
videos.titleEn: ID1 behind the scenes: What it takes to build a semiconductor cleanroom | Micron Technology
videos.originalTitle: ID1 behind the scenes: What it takes to build a semiconductor cleanroom | Micron Technology
videos.author: Micron Technology
videos.scope: Micron Idaho 廠區施工與潔淨度案例，用作跨廠務比較；不是 TSMC 或 imec 的廠內實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Micron Idaho construction and cleanroom example for cross-facility comparison, not footage inside TSMC or imec.
watchFor: 辨認建築完工與製程環境就緒的差別。
觀察氣流、潔淨化與工具進場的相依關係。
列出影像無法證明的粒子與化學污染指標。
watchForEn: Distinguish building completion from process-environment readiness.
Observe dependencies among airflow, clean-up and tool installation.
List particle and chemical-contamination metrics not established by footage.
videos.before: 先畫出人流、物流、氣流的三條路徑。
videos.beforeEn: Sketch separate paths for people, material and air.
videos.after: 建立設備進場前的廠務驗收證據清單。
videos.afterEn: Create a facilities-acceptance evidence list before tool installation.
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯依原平台提供；未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.rights: Official external embed/link only; copyright remains with the publisher. No download or rehosting license is claimed.

videos.title: 晶片如何製成？ASML Nanoland 第 6 集
videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「超純水供應系統」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Ultrapure-water supply systems. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「界定使用點」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Define points of use requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「循環管網」列為查證任務：檢查結果是否能支持「持續循環降低滯留但不能代替材料潔淨度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Trace the recirculation loop: Check whether the evidence supports: Recirculation reduces stagnation but cannot replace material cleanliness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
videos.rights: External official embed/link only. Copyright remains with the publisher; no download or rehosting license is claimed.

verification.availabilityNote: Embedding, regional access and subtitles can change. Open the source page if the player cannot play.

related.transfer: 使用點水質會直接影響清洗末段與晶圓污染。
related.transferEn: Point-of-use water quality directly affects final cleaning and wafer contamination.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是水質多指標、使用點、滯留；「晶圓表面清洗」則以去污效果、材料損失、再污染為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation; Wafer surface cleaning treats removal, material loss and recontamination as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出超純水供應系統與晶圓表面清洗之間的材料或資料交接
用「界定使用點」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項水質多指標、使用點、滯留的觀察，說明還需哪個晶圓表面清洗證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Ultrapure-water supply systems and Wafer surface cleaning
Use define points of use to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation and state which additional Wafer surface cleaning evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 晶圓表面清洗
